notes.title: Small helpers
notes.content:
Added back the small helpers, they dont break the game now, which is great!

We have created a list of 30 things that we think are the most important bugs, features, and fixes. And are planning on slowly releasing these updates over the coming few weeks. Including a brand new starting scene to help transition the player into our game better!

Thanks for all the support!!

notes.title: Water refill HUGE UPDATE
notes.content:
No its not huge. haha. But we did make it so its SUPER easy to refill the water anywhere near any body of water in the game.

We also made it so that the volume slider works on the homepage (again..)

And we added various screensizes to window mode.

notes.title: Space Farm, Release Update
notes.content:
We have finally got the game in a near stable position on PC and Mac. We are now down to final polishing and bug testing. Adding final effects and Audio. Ensuring the questing experience is smooth. Unlocks, farming, marketplace, all the things!

Keep an eye out for our official release date announcement coming very soon!
